findings.description: Submitting an invalid expense (empty title, negative amount, amount with more than 2 decimals such as 12.345, or unknown category) returns HTTP 400 and re-renders a blank Add expense form with no error message, and the entered values are discarded. The user gets no explanation of what was wrong.
repro: POST /expenses with title=Keep me, amount=12.345, category=meals (or bypass browser validation)
Observe a 400 response showing an empty form, with no error text and the title cleared

notes: Checked list/total, category filter (UI and URL), add (flash, one row, persists after reload), edit (list and total update immediately, many amounts), viewer read-only (no controls, direct GET/POST edit/new/delete all 403), anon redirects, delete. All behaved correctly apart from f1.

cost.notes: estimate from 32183 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0064-$0.0772
